incidente.resumo: An erroneous configuration change rolled out to GitHub.com databases impacted their ability to respond to health check pings from the routing service, making the production read-only database endpoint inaccessible; all GitHub services on GitHub.com were inaccessible for all users for 36 minutes. Service was restored by reverting the configuration change and confirming restored connectivity to the databases.

descricao.texto: An erroneous configuration change rolled out to GitHub.com databases at 22:59 UTC impacted the ability of the database to respond to health check pings from the routing service. The database hosts were then considered unhealthy, the production read-only database endpoint became inaccessible, and the application could no longer connect to critical data for read operations, leading to widespread impact starting at 23:02 UTC.
trechos: At 22:59 UTC, an erroneous configuration change rolled out to GitHub.com databases that impacted the ability of the database to respond to health check pings from the routing service.
This led to these database hosts being considered unhealthy and the production read-only database endpoint became inaccessible.
As a result, the application could no longer connect to critical data for read operations.
This led to the widespread impact on GitHub.com starting at 23:02 UTC.

descricao.texto: An erroneous configuration change rolled out to GitHub.com databases; the text does not name the exact setting changed.

passos.texto: The configuration change was reverted and restored connectivity to the databases was confirmed; at 23:38 UTC traffic resumed and all services recovered to full health.
trechos: We mitigated the incident by reverting the configuration change and confirming restored connectivity to our databases.
At 23:38 UTC, traffic resumed and all services recovered to full health.

passos.texto: Monitoring continued before the incident was resolved at 00:30 UTC on August 15.
trechos: Out of an abundance of caution, we continued to monitor before resolving the incident at 00:30 UTC on August 15.

acoes.texto: Already done: additional guardrails were implemented in the database change management process.
trechos: To prevent recurrence we have implemented additional guardrails in our database change management process.

acoes.texto: Planned: several repair items are being prioritized, such as faster rollback functionality and more resilience to dependency failures, all at the highest priority.
trechos: We are also prioritizing several repair items, such as faster rollback functionality and more resilience to dependency failures.
Given the severity of this incident, all repair items are being worked on at the highest priority.
On August 14, between 23:02 and 23:38 UTC, all GitHub services on GitHub.com were inaccessible for all users.

motivo_confianca_baixa: prevencao: the actions (additional guardrails, faster rollback, more resilience to dependency failures) are named but not detailed, so genericas was chosen over especificas. data_incidente is null because the text gives August 14 without a year. gatilho is null because the configuration change is itself the defect with no separate pre-existing condition described.
